entries.verification_note: S.D. Const. art. XI, section 2 (https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Constitution/11-2) empowers the Legislature to impose graduated taxes upon incomes rather than prohibiting a personal income tax, while https://sdlegislature.gov/Constitution/Article/11 returns a script shell. The Governor's Office of Economic Development tax-climate page (https://sdgoed.com/why-sd/tax-climate/) states that South Dakota imposes no personal income tax, leaving the held constitutional-basis attribution unconfirmed.
